entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: The instant criminal petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C)/under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS') has been filed by the Petitioners/Accused Nos.1 to 3, seeking quashment of the proceedings pending against them in C.C. No. 485 of 2022 on the file of learned Additional Junior Civil Judge, Chilakaluripet, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A of IPC & Sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Heard Sri T.V.P.Sai Vihari, learned counsel for the Petitioners/Accused Nos.1 to 3 and Ms.
K.Priyanka Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor on behalf of the State.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners would further submit that the petition may be disposed of without causing any prejudice to the rights and contentions of the petitioners by dispensing the presence of the petitioners before the Trial Court.
4. Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that the Court may pass appropriate orders.
5. Considering the submissions, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
However, the presence of the petitioner Nos. 2 and 3/A2 & A3 before the Trial Court is dispensed with, unless their presence is specifically directed by the Trial Court.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

Dr. JUSTICE VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA Date: 08.09.2025 UPS HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA CRIMINAL PETITION NO: 9235/2025 Dated.08.09.2025 UPS Bandla Ajay Babu vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123006982/
